    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # the repeating fill color where a junction is unmarked.
    clue = 9 if 9 in {v for row in grid for v in row} else 1
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if clue in row]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == clue for r in range(h))]
    dr = min((b-a for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:])), default=1)
    dc = min((b-a for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:])), default=1)
    rs = list(range(rs[0], h, dr))
    cs = list(range(cs[0], w, dc))
    # Each macro-cell is represented by its upper-left lattice intersection;
